notes.title: Magical Bakery - Patch 1.3.2
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone!

We're so excited to share a tasty new update for Magical Bakery today! Version 1.3.2 for Steam is now live, and we've baked up several important fixes and enhancements so you can keep your bakery running smoothly.

We hope you enjoy these updates! We're brewing up more enhancements to make your experience in Magical Bakery even better, so keep an eye out! Once again, thank you for your continued support!

Magical Bakery Patch 1.3.2 (Steam):

 Limit the number of letters that player is able to use when naming the character.
 To implement an option to close the inventory with the back button
 [JAP] Code string is visible during the dialogue with Baba.
 VFX - Ice aura looks grey.
 Code String appears on some tutorials when them are displayed.
  Place holder present in dialogue text when player interacts with Arbal.
  Turn pages by pressing D-pad is mentioned in the Grimoire tutorial however LT and RT are displayed in the game.
The game gets stuck on the confirmation prompt after pressing the Options button while transitioning downstairs or upstairs.
"Any Regrets" achievement does not get unlocked even after selling ingredients back to Shen.
Spoiled Sweet Turns into Burned Sweet After Bringing It from Bedroom to Kitchen.
 Some words displayed during tutorial text are incorrectly positioned outside their intended layout.
 Debug symbols are displayed during the conversations on multiple instances in Simplified and Traditional Chinese languages. --> PENDING TO CONFIRM FIX.
 Chalkboard items disappearing when moving to bedroom on same day.
 The applied color blindness setting is inconsistent when the user approaches an interactable object in the bedroom.
 Player can give spoiled Favorite sweet to NPC characters. --> PENDING TO CONFIRM FIX.
 The "Your Trusted Blacksmith" trophy incorrectly unlocks after purchasing all upgrades under the Bakery category.
 The "Baba's Comfort" trophy fails to unlock after purchasing all bedroom upgrades from Amber.
 Ordered Parcel/Courier disappears after going upstairs and coming back to the kitchen area.
 The "Recycling" trophy fails to unlock after acquiring all ingredients from a baked sweet from Bob.
 Customer accepts, eats and pays for the burnt sweet.
 Ingredients Mixture Disappears When the Player Starts Mixing and Moves to Bed.
 Debug symbols are displayed during the conversation with Baba before the introduction of Ludovar.
 Water element tutorial triggers again if the player character returns after visiting the bedroom.
 Elementals goes to sleep mode if the player character visits the bedroom and returns.
 A few letters are already present in the text box after playing the Over tutorial in Japanese language.
 Colour changes in bedroom when applying colour blindness option.
 Thief Tutorial Bell.


Thanks, 
-SUPERLUMEN & SOEDESCO
